words.definition: a special quality that endears other people to the person who has this quality
words.example: She has charisma that no other candidate possesses.
words.zh: 一種特殊的品質，使具有這種品質的人受到其他人的喜愛

words.definition: to make someone see things your way
words.example: They could not convince the girls to go to the dance with them.
words.zh: 讓某人以你的方式看待事物

words.example: How he is able to endure living next to the airport is beyond my comprehension.

words.definition: to give up; have something taken away, usually by rule or regulation
words.example: You may have to forfeit your home country's citizenship to become a citizen of another country.
words.zh: 放棄；通常根據規則或規定拿走某些東西

words.example: The diver put himself in a precarious situation among the sharks.
The weather service issued a severe storm warning for most of Michigan.
The radio communications were subject to sporadic sunspot interference.

words.definition: to discover or run into a person or thing accidentally
words.example: She stumbled upon a lot of interesting information about her research topic.
words.zh: 意外發現或遇到某人或某物

words.definition: excellent quality; above all the rest
words.example: This is a superior fossil of a trilobite.

words.definition: to shorten: to end something suddenly
words.example: The television program was truncated because the soccer match went into extra time.

words.definition: done without thought or consideration; grossly negligent
words.example: Her wanton disregard of the rules was unexplainable.
words.zh: 未經思考或考慮而做出的；嚴重疏忽

words.example: There is a widespread rumor that there will be no class next Thursday.
It is often said that wisdom is the product of experience.

words.zh: 一個笑話；一個有趣的故事：

words.definition: to make efforts to attain or gain something
words.example: The directors tried to woo the support of the union.
